children: was $13.62 as of Aug. 31, 2026, down a penny from its estimated book value per share of $13.63 on July 31, 2026, the company said Thursday.

Its closing stock price on Aug. 31, 2026, was $13.38, a 1.8% discount to the estimated book value. By comparison, its stock traded at a 2.6% discount to its estimated book value per share a month earlier.
